description.en: TriViewBench evaluates multimodal LLMs on multi-view structural reasoning using synthetic 3D scenes with controlled object count and occlusion. It comprises 1,923 scenes and over 14,000 QA pairs across four complexity levels and three reasoning categories: Local Decision, Object Counting, and Global Recovery.

evidence.snippet: We introduce TriViewBench, a controlled three-view visual reasoning benchmark constructed from synthetic 3D scenes with explicitly parameterized object count and occlusion.

claire_radar.motivation: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate strong performance on standard visual question answering benchmarks, yet their scalability under controlled structural complexity remains poorly understood.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: TriViewBench provides controlled complexity scaling to isolate structural reasoning capabilities in MLLMs, revealing distinct failure modes and bottlenecks. It enables systematic comparison of models on multi-view spatial reasoning, informing targeted improvements.
